title.ko: 처칠이 루스벨트에게 보낸 전보 — 슬레지해머를 접고 북아프리카로 (1942년 7월 8일)
title.en: Churchill to Roosevelt: Telegram on Sledgehammer and Gymnast (8 July 1942)

description.ko: 영국 참모총장 누구도 1942년 프랑스 상륙(슬레지해머)을 권고하지 않는다며 이를 거부하고, 프랑스령 북아프리카 상륙(짐내스트)을 「1942년의 진정한 제2전선」으로 내놓은 처칠의 전보.
description.en: Churchill's telegram telling Roosevelt that no responsible British commander would recommend Sledgehammer in 1942 and proposing the French North Africa landing (Gymnast) as 'the true Second Front of 1942'.

source: Former Naval Person to President, 8 July 1942 (Churchill Archives Centre CHAR 20/77/87-90). Text as printed in Winston S. Churchill, The Second World War, vol. IV: The Hinge of Fate (London: Cassell, 1951), pp. 391–392; scan: Internet Archive in.ernet.dli.2015.191153 (https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.191153), accessed 2026-10-07.
